title: Needs you shows only the owner's three decisions; the blocker and the review escalation stay with the Master
description: Owner direction 2026-11-15 (GY-3394): Needs you lists only goals and priorities, money and accounts, and credentials for people. With an ordinary blocker, a review escalation, an account login request and a goal question open at once, Needs you carries exactly the account and goal entries — the human-only list names only the two parks, and the board groups the blocker and the review escalation under Blocked, never Needs you — and the Master page shows the other two. On the base tip the two 40-minute-old blockers reach Needs you instead and the Master page names neither, so the case fails there.
